items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Oh, yes. Yes, they used to come through there.

ctx.x: Did bands like Papa Celestin's ever get to Lake Charles?

Oh, yes. Yes, they used to come through there. Sure they'd come there. You know, they played one nighters. They could never play more than one night there. You know, the people just wouldn't support it, but they would support that one night. They used to come to Lake Charles, and then they would go into Texas, you see, go maybe as far as San Antonio or El Paso.
What other bands came through there that you got to see, that you can remember?
